start: Phone with a watch screen diary, Settings > Help and feedback

steps.action: Type a message and turn on 'Add my watch's screen log'
user_sees: Caption 'It helps us fix a watch screen that goes dark. It holds only the times your watch screen turned on, off or dim, and your watch's Battery Saver and screen settings.'
must_not: The switch on by default

steps.action: Tap Send
user_sees: The message is sent
'Your watch screen log was sent too.'
must_not: The log sent without the switch
The message lost because the log failed

start: The feedback button on another screen

steps.action: Open the feedback sheet, turn on 'Add my watch's screen log', send
user_sees: 'Your watch screen log was sent too.'
must_not: A different switch text or a log sent with the switch off

start: The watch log cannot be read or the feedback box refuses it

steps.action: Send a message with the switch on
user_sees: 'Your message was sent, but the watch screen log was not. Try again later.'
must_not: 'Sent too' when the log failed
The message itself not sent

steps.action: Send a message
user_sees: The message is sent
must_not: Any watch log in the feedback box

start: Switch on, the member trusts the caption

steps.action: Send a message with the log
user_sees: Only what the caption lists leaves the phone
must_not: The watch app version, the update pop-up's last choice, the phone model or a sender id sent without the caption saying so
Any watch name, workout or heart rate
